newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan state airliner traffic up 9.3 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Jordan state airliner traffic up 9.3 pct in H1.

text.p: Jordan's state carrier Royal Jordanian Airlines saw a 9.3 percent rise in passenger traffic in the first half of 1997 compared to the same period last year, its planning department said on Monday.
Royal Jordanian carried 656,930 passengers in the first six months of 1997 and passenger seat factor stood at 66.3 percent against 63.3 percent in the same period last year.
Total cargo during the same six month period rose 13.8 percent to 37,676 tonnes compared to the same period last year.
Traffic was markedly higher on the Indian, North African, Middle and Far Eastern and Gulf routes the airline said.
